id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_070.pack|cs_: "The man-eating fire dragon! The man-eating fire dragon has appeared!!
"That's the dragon from the volcano! It came to attack the village after all!
"D-Don't flinch, everyone! Protect the village from that evil flame avatar...!
"I know. You're hungry. Then take me... So leave the villagers alone...
"Aaaah! Miko... Miko was eaten by the man-eating fire dragon!!
"Damn you! Avenge Lady Miko...! Fire! Fire!!
"At this rate the dragon will wreck the village...!
"Please, brother! Defeat that man-eating dragon! Or the village... the village...!!"
